svg.text: Arduino Uno reads all sensors and drives the robot; the ESP32-CAM streams video and serves the dashboard.
Drawn: ResQBot team · Date: 2026-10-18 · Resistors ¼ W 5 %
VIN unused: the 5 V rail feeds the Uno's 5V pin
Phone ⇄ Wi-Fi ResQBot-01 ⇄ U2 ESP32-CAM ⇄ serial 115200 ⇄ U1 Uno ⇄ sensors and motors
Net flags with the same name are connected. GND is common to every module.
